subtitle: Feedback for websites, shops and events
description:
Put a feedback button on your website with one script tag, or a QR code on your tables, counter or event badges. People send praise, problems and ideas from their phone, with a photo in one tap.

Make the form your own: ask for an email or a phone number, and add a few questions like a table number or which meal. Each project gets a page with your title, logo and cover, a custom address and a poster to print.

Everything arrives in one inbox per project. Filter by status, kind or any answer, keep a thread of notes for your team, and see how many people scanned, visited and sent something.
whatsNew: A form of your own: ask for an email or phone, and add short answers, dropdowns, one-choice and checkbox questions. The inbox filters by kind, answer, photos or words, and each item keeps a thread of your team's notes and changes.
